error.too_long: This card can wait at most __max__ seconds, because Homey ends a Flow that has been waiting any longer. Use Homey's own Delay block for longer pauses.
error.invalid_duration: "__duration__" is not a duration. Fill in a number greater than zero.
error.unknown_unit: Unknown unit "__unit__". Choose milliseconds or seconds.
error.too_many: Already waiting __max__ times at once. A Flow is most likely retriggering faster than its own wait can finish.
error.aborted: The wait was cancelled because the app stopped.
